$provenance.contract: C0 §1 Serialization — cross-language temporal wire formats
$provenance.source: goals/c0-contracts.md (§1: date YYYY-MM-DD; time HH:mm:ss; datetime = RFC 3339 UTC instant; duration = ISO 8601; timezone = IANA id, never offsets/abbreviations)
$provenance.authority: These are the binding C0 cases the Dart family shares with the ts/cs/go families. This artifact is the fixture consumed by the conformance suite; the suite creates no ad hoc temporal values of its own.
$provenance.ianaNote: The timezone cases are mechanically consistent with the IANA release baked into isIanaTimeZone (see lib/src/iana_zones.dart, regenerated by tool/gen_iana_zones.dart). A valid case must be a member of that release; an invalid case must not be.
